edits.current: Rule to be set at implementation: the file extension follows the published DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4 (Res. 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1, entry T3.45).
edits.proposed: xml - the file is an XML document named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml, where cc = 01 for an insertion or 02 for a replacement, mmmmm = the format code 02276, vv = the version 04, aaaa = the year (four digits) and cccccccc = the consecutive file number. Each file carries at most 5,000 records; a population above 5,000 beneficiaries is sent in several files distinguished by the consecutive number (DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4, Res. 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1, entry T3.45).

edits.current: - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself prescribes no XSD: the element names, ordering and lengths are fixed by the technical specifications of Format 2276 version 4, so every element path in this specification is a logical name marked DERIVED, to be mapped to the published technical specifications at implementation.
edits.proposed: - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself prescribes no XSD: the element names, ordering and lengths are fixed by the technical specifications of Format 2276 version 4, so every element path in this specification is a logical name marked DERIVED, mapped to the element names of the published technical specifications. The physical file is an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year, cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file.

edits.proposed: Public-sector only. Public-sector employees are reported through PILA return types T and F, which are outside the scope of this specification.

Not payroll income. Fees paid to a non-executive director who holds no employment contract are not generated by the payroll engine, and payroll contributes nothing to the record. Res. 227 par. 5 governs their reporting: where the fee was withheld under ET art. 383 it is reported in Format 2276 numeral 9 (fees) by the employer's tax function, outside payroll; where art. 383 did not apply it is reported in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead (see 'Natural person paid work income OUTSIDE an employment relationship' below).
NO

Numerals 30 and 31 are not payroll figures: Colombian employment income carries no VAT. They are relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the ET art. 383 table, are populated by the employer's tax function outside payroll, and are written as zero on every employee record (Res. 227 para. 2).
NO

Format 2276 is annual and carries one record per beneficiary to whom work or pension income was paid or credited in account in the tax year (Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1). A beneficiary whose withholding was nil still gets a record, with zero in every value numeral (par. 2 - see 'Employee whose withholding was nil'). Where no work or pension income was paid or credited in account to any person in the tax year there is no beneficiary and payroll generates no Format 2276 record; the format has no nil record. A monthly nil period does not arise for this return: every amount is an annual accumulation by payment date.

edits.current: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE: Employee.Document_Type and Employee.Document_Number in the employee master data. Where the master data holds no type-code field and stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Identity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID), the engine holds an explicit Employee.Document_Type derived once from the populated column through a document-type mapping table supplied at implementation, with a priority rule where more than one column is filled. POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not active employees in the master data - their document type and number are retained after termination and held for every pensioner. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (payroll field 'Beneficiary National Id', typically on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.
edits.proposed: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE: Employee.Document_Type and Employee.Document_Number in the employee master data. Where the master data holds no type-code field and stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Identity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID), the engine holds an explicit Employee.Document_Type derived once from the populated column through the document-type mapping table, maintained as a configuration table that maps each master-data document column to one DIAN code of the 'Tipo de documento' table and fixes the priority order between the columns where more than one is filled; a document outside the DIAN table cannot be reported under another code. POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not active employees in the master data - their document type and number are retained after termination and held for every pensioner. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (payroll field 'Beneficiary National Id', typically on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment: a survivor or substitute pension is reported in a record in the name of the person who receives the pension, with that person's document type and number - the same identity rule as Form 220 casilla 50, issued in the recipient's name. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.

edits.current: COMPOSITE FIELD - the beneficiary's location block of the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025): address, department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, and country. COUNTRY IS ALWAYS MANDATORY. Address, department and municipality are mandatory only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia only the country is reported and address, department and municipality are left empty. The country here is the country of the beneficiary's address, not a tax-residence marker. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE: Employee.Department_Code and Employee.Municipality_Code, held as DIVIPOLA codes in the employee master data, with the address and the country taken from the same employee address record; where the master data holds a letter department code and a free-text city, the codes are obtained through a maintained mapping table validated against DIVIPOLA and supplied at implementation. Free text must never be sent in the department, municipality or country sub-fields. Location is retained for leavers and held for employer-paid pensioners.

COUNTRY IS ALWAYS MANDATORY. Address, department and municipality are mandatory only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia only the country is reported and address, department and municipality are left empty. The country here is the country of the beneficiary's address, not a tax-residence marker. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE: Employee.Department_Code and Employee.Municipality_Code, held as DIVIPOLA codes in the employee master data, with the address and the country taken from the same employee address record; where the master data holds a letter department code and a free-text city, the codes are obtained through the DIVIPOLA mapping table, maintained as a configuration table that maps each master-data department letter code and city name to its DANE department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) code, every entry validated against the DIVIPOLA catalogue. Free text must never be sent in the department, municipality or country sub-fields. Location is retained for leavers and held for employer-paid pensioners.

edits.current: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, habitual bonuses, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Habitual bonuses - bonuses paid regularly as part of the remuneration, whatever their label - are reported here; a non-habitual, one-off bonus is reported in numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro). Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator, which also marks items that belong to other numerals (vacation pay, numeral 12; per diems, numeral 13 - every per diem, including a permanent salary-type per diem, element pavia). Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36, which likewise carries the habitual bonuses, and must equal it for the same employee and year.
edits.proposed: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, habitual bonuses, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Habitual bonuses - bonuses paid regularly as part of the remuneration, whatever their label - are reported here; a non-habitual, one-off bonus is reported in numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro). Payments in kind that constitute salary (CST arts. 127 and 129) are reported here (element pasa); payments in kind that are not salary are reported in numeral 17 (element potro); the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator, which also marks items that belong to other numerals (vacation pay, numeral 12; per diems, numeral 13 - every per diem, including a permanent salary-type per diem, element pavia). Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36, which likewise carries the habitual bonuses, and must equal it for the same employee and year.

edits.current: Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro): non-habitual, one-off bonuses (a habitual bonus goes to numeral 5, element pasa), non-salary allowances, payments in kind to third parties for the employee's benefit, equity-based compensation, termination indemnities, and one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension - a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement - while the pension itself goes to numeral 21 (element peju). Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary. In-kind and informative wage types (paid to third parties or abroad, e.g. the 'Inf.' and foreign-paid wage types) are explicitly classified wage type by wage type in the classification table supplied at implementation. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.
edits.proposed: Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro): non-habitual, one-off bonuses (a habitual bonus goes to numeral 5, element pasa), non-salary allowances, payments in kind that are not salary - including payments to third parties for the employee's benefit - (a payment in kind that constitutes salary goes to numeral 5, element pasa; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC)), equity-based compensation, termination indemnities, and one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension - a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement - while the pension itself goes to numeral 21 (element peju). Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary. Informative wage types paid to third parties (the 'Inf.' wage types) and foreign-paid wage types are classified wage type by wage type on the same attributes: a wage type that is income of the beneficiary is reported in numeral 5 where it carries the salary attribute and here where it does not, whatever the payment channel; a wage type that records no income of the beneficiary (e.g. a reimbursement or an employer-cost informative entry) is excluded; a meal payment to a food supplier follows the numeral 7 / 8 / 32 rule; and the income of a non-resident for work performed entirely outside Colombia is foreign-source and is not reported in this return (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019). Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.

edits.current: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: where the employer pays company pensions directly through payroll (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), this numeral is populated and the pensioner population, which is not part of the active employee master data, is included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Only the pension itself - the periodic retirement, old-age or invalidity pension payments - is reported here (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element peju); a lump-sum or one-off payment to a retiree that is not a pension (a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement) is reported in numeral 17 (element potro). Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.
edits.proposed: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: where the employer pays company pensions directly through payroll (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), this numeral is populated and the pensioner population, which is not part of the active employee master data, is included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Only the pension itself - the periodic retirement, old-age or invalidity pension payments - is reported here (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element peju); a lump-sum or one-off payment to a retiree that is not a pension (a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement) is reported in numeral 17 (element potro). A survivor or substitute pension paid by the employer is reported in the record of the person who receives it, identified in numeral 2 with the recipient's own document type and number - not in a record of the deceased pensioner - the same identity rule as Form 220 casilla 50, issued in the recipient's name. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55. DISTINCT from numeral 26. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the configuration attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)'. The attribute is assigned per wage type in the classification table supplied at implementation, across the voluntary-pension deduction wage types - the '(FVOL)' provider wage types 25811-25815 and 25823 and the institutional-plan wage types 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803 and 65804 - each of which is classified as art. 55 (numeral 25) or art. 126-1 (numeral 26). A combined APV total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.
edits.proposed: Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55. DISTINCT from numeral 26. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types 25811-25815 and 25823 and the institutional-plan wage types 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803 and 65804 - each of which carries exactly one of the two attributes, art. 55 (numeral 25) or art. 126-1 (numeral 26). A combined APV total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the configuration attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The attribute is assigned per wage type in the classification table supplied at implementation, across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804). Employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from employee contributions; the employer- or employee-side nature of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804) is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
edits.proposed: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804). Employee contributions deducted through payroll are reported here; employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from them through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804), which also comes from the WTC. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.

edits.current: Ahorro para el Fomento de la Construccion: the employee's AFC contributions withheld through payroll in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the AFC deduction wage types (one wage type per bank, 'AFC <bank>'), summed across banks. Rule to be set at implementation: the treatment of AFC reimbursement / reversal wage types ('Reimbursement AFC') in the annual accumulation. Maps to Form 220 casilla 57 and to electronic payroll NIE179.
edits.proposed: Ahorro para el Fomento de la Construccion: the employee's AFC contributions withheld through payroll in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the AFC deduction wage types (one wage type per bank, 'AFC <bank>'), summed across banks. A reimbursement / reversal wage type ('Reimbursement AFC') reverses an AFC deduction through payroll and is netted against the AFC deductions of the same tax year, so that the numeral carries the net amount actually withheld for the AFC account in the year (ET art. 126-4 counts the sums deposited in the account); the annual net value is reported as a positive integer, zero where the net is nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025). Maps to Form 220 casilla 57 and to electronic payroll NIE179.

edits.current: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8 (element vaex), which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026); where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop) and this numeral stays nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pagahuvt). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' (e.g. 'Meal Allowance Inf.'); the tag is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation and is applied only to meal payments made to a food supplier.
edits.proposed: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8 (element vaex), which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026); where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop) and this numeral stays nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pagahuvt). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) carrying the 'meal paid to a third party' attribute (e.g. 'Meal Allowance Inf.'); the attribute comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) and is carried only by meal payments made to a food supplier.
